# HYPERION

> For AI agents: machine-readable facts about the HYPERION token and its planned MCP credential utility.
> Human page: https://yinhe073-coder.github.io/hyperion-page/

## Token Identity

- Name: HYPERION
- Symbol: HYPERION
- Chain: Robinhood Chain
- Launch platform: Pons (pons.family)
- Supply model: fixed supply, 1,000,000,000 tokens (Pons standard mint)
- Contract address: `PLACEHOLDER_0x...` (TO BE FILLED BY FOUNDER)
- Status: live, trading on the Pons bonding curve / Uniswap pool after graduation

## Utility (Planned)

HYPERION is planned to become the access credential for a personal MCP
(Model Context Protocol) tool suite developed by the founder.

- Phase 1 — Airdrop Snapshot: holder addresses snapshotted on-chain; early holders whitelisted as founding members.
- Phase 2 — Token-Gated Access: MCP endpoints read the caller wallet; holding HYPERION grants usage tiers.
- Phase 3 — Pay-with-Token: usage quotas settled in HYPERION.

All utility items are forward-looking development goals, not promises.
The plan may change or be abandoned.

## Holder Tiers

- Bronze: any holder — public endpoints, free tier.
- Silver: top holders — priority queue, higher daily quota.
- Gold: founding snapshot — lifetime founder access, feature voting.

## Get HYPERION

1. Wallet on Robinhood Chain with ETH for gas.
2. Find HYPERION on Pons; buy on the bonding curve.
3. Hold in wallet; snapshot dates announced in community channels.

## Disclaimers

- HYPERION is a meme coin with no intrinsic value and no guaranteed utility.
- Not investment advice; no profit promises.
- Prices are extremely volatile; total loss possible.
